text: Interviewing Putin is important because, in spite of its dangers, most Americans are not informed about what’s happening in Russia and they deserve to know so they can have better accountability over US foreign policy
The role of journalism is to provide a population with complete and unbiased information

The war in Ukraine is a human disaster and its long-term effects are even more consequential, such as the loss of USD value, and this is a reality that most of the world perceive except for Western populations
Western populations are misinformed by their media, which tend to ignore Russian opinions because of normative biases in favour of Ukraine
For this purpose, we offer this interview freely, while we suspect that mainstream news media won’t because of normative or other biases
Putin is a criminal or morally reproachable person that does not deserve to be platformed
Ukraine deserved to be defended, so giving Putin a platform amounts to treason
Putin is not a trusted source
The interview does not due diligence of critiquing or questioning the interviewee
The statement that USD has lost its value is factually incomplete
The video ignores the that Russian government is itself censoring dissident viewpoints
Western media has never suppressed Russian or Putin’s viewpoints
The war in Ukraine is a special military operation
What Tucker expresses is an opinion and does not need to be verified
While the interview is valid, Tucker does not do due diligence on context
Western journalists have repeatedly asked to interview Putin since the invasion, and the Kremlin turned them down
Reporting on a leader who declines an interview is normal and ethical journalism
